reviews.title: UI update
reviews.text:
Love the new UI update. It’s a better experience now, I can’t deny that. 
But the feature(for the Nigerian region) where we see job recent listings that match our frequent searches and similar ones is gone. It’s available to other regions but Nigeria. We have to search and use the filters, which leads to seeing older listings and some that doesn’t correlate with the role being sought. It’ll be a big one if you’ll help restore the said feature. 
Thank you. The team has been doing a really great job with the app. Bless you all.
